strategy: Use this cached operation sequence; do not rediscover UI paths when AX succeeds.

launch.condition: one app-owned window with width 480-560 and height 600-680 (main panel, measured 520x640) via CGWindowList or AXWindows, polled up to 8s
launch.purpose: launch must have visible evidence, not just a live process
status menu items reachable through AX; discovery only, no menu-item press; transient menu closed afterwards (best effort)

flash_notes.purpose: force main panel visible and centered

clipboard.purpose: open menu bar extra; tolerate actionFailed and verify AXChildren; skip the press when the menu is already open
clipboard search commits immediately; wait for async search completion

launcher.purpose: open menu bar extra; tolerate actionFailed and verify AXChildren

settings.purpose: launcher/clipboard panels of earlier suites hide on focus loss; click a neutral desktop spot and wait them out so they cannot cover the settings overlay
keyboard events do not reach the app in the smoke environment; the status menu item posts showSettings which opens the overlay inside the main panel

settings.condition: AXStaticText 偏好设置 present in the AX tree
tab buttons AI/记录/剪贴板 exposed via AXDescription
AI tab content marker (AI 自动提炼…) present before switching

settings.policy: read-only: tab state is transient UI, no preference is written

settings.condition: 启用剪贴板历史 present AND AI tab marker gone — content really changed

settings.note: panel-header gear (desc settings) is the fallback toggle

settings.condition: settings overlay gone (no 偏好设置 header text, no tab buttons in AX tree)

devcore.condition: DevCore status visible and isolated storage reported

screenshot-toolbar.note: do not replace with Escape/shortcut: keyboard events do not reach the app in the smoke environment (2026-11-27)

screenshot-toolbar.purpose: overlay window exists != interaction ready; early synthetic drags get dropped (verified 2026-10-21)

screenshot-toolbar.value: right-edge selection: (1178,300)->(1398,480) in logical pt (cua coords are native px = pt * px_per_pt)

screenshot-toolbar.condition: blue highlight cluster (b>160, r<80, 70<g<150) with record dot at highlight.x+534 on the archived frame stage1_default
toolbar widened by 234pt: record dot now at highlight.x+692; highlight stays at the click point minus edge yield — no jump to a re-centered position (stage2_widened)

screenshot-toolbar.purpose: end session by mouse; Escape never reaches the app in the smoke environment

screenshot-toolbar.condition: highlight found at default width on stage3_mid_default
highlight stays exactly at the click point (no edge yield possible) — distinguishes left-edge anchoring from the old re-centering behavior (stage4_mid_text)

screenshot-toolbar.value: every stage frame the assertions ran on is saved to screenshots/screenshot-toolbar-frame-<stage>-<ts>.png with annotation boxes; report Evidence lists the file names

selector_priority: window-relative coordinate with fresh window frame
screenshot/model review only for failure diagnosis
